what_happened: The job to tell verifiers to reuse Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test results (a prompts-class change) failed. The producer stage did not finish and hit its 1800-second deadline. No work product was delivered. The event lists no unmet criteria, findings or failed checks. The time limit ended the job, not a verdict on the work. This is the third job on this same prompt edit to end this way: the earlier job 20261019-013309-nvbb failed the same way, and this one looks like its re-run.
cause: The producer runs against one fixed wall-clock deadline. Nothing reports progress, saves partial work, or tells a stalled producer from a slow one. A failed job can be re-run unchanged, so the same request hit the same wall again with no new information. Nothing checks whether the request is really small. Telling verifiers to trust recorded results touches how results are found, recorded and trusted, so it may be wider than a prompt edit. The class was already recorded twice and no guard was added, so repeats are allowed.
prevention: Give the producer stage a progress signal and an early stop. It should write a checkpoint of its partial diff and a short status note at set intervals. If it makes no progress for a set period, it should stop early and report what it found, not run to the full 1800 seconds. Add a retry rule: when a job has already failed at the producer deadline, a re-run must not repeat the same request unchanged. It must either be narrowed to one concrete edit or start from the saved partial result. Before dispatch, check that a prompts-class job names the exact prompt file and the exact sentence or section to change.
proposed_request: In the verifier prompt, add one short instruction: when Athena's recorded results for fmt, clippy and tests exist for the exact commit under review, the verifier reads and relies on them and does not re-run those checks. If no recorded result exists for that commit, it runs the checks as before. Change only the verifier prompt file, with no code, config or other prompt edits. Done when the prompt contains this instruction and the repo's existing tests pass. If you cannot finish within the time limit, stop early and report the partial diff and what remains.
